placeholders.<hash>: the tree hash a receipt names
placeholders.<verdict>: ok, or failed with the failed steps
placeholders.<step>: a gate step: import, check, strict, lint, arch, boot or test
placeholders.<reason>: the reason field of a godotkit JSON line
placeholders.<reach change>: max files reached now and its change against the base commit
placeholders.<count>: a finding count from the survey
placeholders.<file contents>: the full text of a file to write

placeholders.<id>: an asset id, such as door-mc5b
placeholders.<endpoint>: the provider's model or endpoint id
placeholders.<prompt>: the prompt the file was generated from
placeholders.<request id>: the provider's job or request id
placeholders.<status>: a folded status: pending_review, retake, approved, final, rejected or deprecated
placeholders.<next step>: what happens to the asset next

placeholders.<question>: a design question as the owner sees it
placeholders.<option>: one answer option, concrete enough to build
placeholders.<reason>: why a recommendation or an N/A holds
placeholders.<consequence>: what changes in the game with the answer
placeholders.<decision id>: a decision record id, such as 0042-oxygen-schedule
placeholders.<chosen, or open>: the chosen label, or open when unanswered
placeholders.<ids, or nothing>: decision ids a record supersedes, or nothing
placeholders.<topic>: a canon topic id, such as survival
placeholders.<document>: the path of a topic's owning document
placeholders.<what changed>: the change made to a canon topic
placeholders.<contract id>: a contract id, such as pressure_leak
placeholders.<fields>: contract fields still OPEN or missing
placeholders.<rule or sheet question>: a designkit rule or a review sheet question
placeholders.<where>: a node, file and line, or record the finding names
placeholders.<one-line detail>: what is wrong, in one line
placeholders.<skill>: the skill that closes the finding
placeholders.<YYYY-MM-DD>: the date the report was written
placeholders.<slug>: a short kebab-case name of the research question

placeholders.<model id>: the id of the model that wrote the text, such as claude-opus-5-5
placeholders.<locale>: a locale code, such as ru or pt_BR
placeholders.<namespace>: a namespace, the file name under i18n/src
placeholders.<key>: a string key, such as UI_EXIT
placeholders.<text>: the source text of a string
placeholders.<finding>: one QA finding: category, severity and detail
placeholders.<context>: the tr() context: who speaks or where the text shows
placeholders.<note>: guidance for translators: what the text is and what each placeholder holds
placeholders.<n>: a count from a l10nkit JSON line
placeholders.<rule>: the rule of a finding, such as hardcoded or placeholders
placeholders.<where>: where a finding is: file:line or KEY@locale
placeholders.<detail>: the detail text of a finding
